name: shelf-watch

scripts.build: npm run build -w shelf-api && npm run build -w shelf-web-client

overridesNote: drizzle-kit depends on the abandoned @esbuild-kit/* packages, which pin an esbuild with a dev-server advisory (GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99). No drizzle-kit release has dropped them. Forcing a patched esbuild dedupes the nested copy away and clears the advisory. Do NOT run `npm audit fix --force` instead: it downgrades drizzle-kit 0.31 -> 0.18.
